body:
Parent epic: #229

Depends on the authoritative baseline ticket created under #229.

## Objective

Reduce the dominant SRP LUT and FF scaling term without changing SRP protocol behaviour or supported stream counts.

Historical 8×8 Vivado results attributed 6,014 LUTs, or 52 percent of `KL_pp_shadow`, to `KL_srp_top`.

## Scope

- [ ] Measure talker FSM, listener FSM, top glue, decoder, encoder, and admission logic independently.
- [ ] Identify combinational logic replicated once per talker or listener.
- [ ] Share or time-multiplex logic where protocol latency permits.
- [ ] Pack per-stream state and context into RAM-friendly structures.
- [ ] Ensure inactive stream slots disappear during elaboration in smaller configurations.
- [ ] Document the marginal cost of every additional talker and listener.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Current SRP tests pass for 1×1 and 8×8 configurations.
- [ ] Before-and-after hierarchical Vivado reports show a material reduction against the same baseline.
- [ ] The 1×1 configuration contains no logic for seven inactive stream slots.
- [ ] Timing at 100 MHz does not regress below zero WNS.
- [ ] Scaling and any latency tradeoffs are documented in #229.
title: [Optimisation] Reduce KL_pp_shadow SRP per-stream replication
